newsitem.title: USA: AFL-CIO's Sweeney lauds Herman as labor secretary.
newsitem.headline: AFL-CIO's Sweeney lauds Herman as labor secretary.

text.p: AFL-CIO President John Sweeney Friday lauded President Clinton's nomination of Alexis Herman as secretary of labor, even though he had supported former Sen. Harris Wofford, Democrat-Pa., for the job.
"Alexis Herman is a wonderful choice for secretary of labor," Sweeney said in a statement.

"Over the years, she has had an excellent relationship with me and other union leaders," said Sweeney. "In recent weeks, I have met and talked with her a number of times and I know she is committed to putting together a strong team to fight for good jobs, justice and dignity for America's working families."
Herman, a White House aide, would succeed Robert Reich, who has enjoyed a close relationship with organized labor. The 78 unions of the AFL-CIO represent 13.1 million workers.
